content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Nathaniel Young (E031)
Request: write access to Payroll

Two notes in team memory with conflicting information:

Note 1: Says employee is full-time Payroll Specialist, recommends write.
Note 2: Says security record shows contractor with basic security training, recommends read. Security record takes precedence per the note.

According to policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If the employee is a contractor with basic training, max is read. Requested write is above max, so grant read.

The note says security record takes precedence. So the contractor status with basic training is the fact. Maximum access = read. Requested write > max, so grant read.

Decision: read.
